answer: Sybil resistance arises because reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so an identity must provide sustained, honest service to retain influence. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocal, trusted interactions can raise it only gradually. A mesa of mutually endorsing sybils cannot manufacture credible transitivity, and neither a cipher nor a brief pulse of activity substitutes for accumulated trust, leaving such identities unable to pass consensus thresholds.
